name: CRACK_DIABOLO
comment: msg_presents reads DIABOLO  PRESENTS in SAEGER, DATASOFT PRESENTS in TBC and DC.

name: FIX_RAM_TEST_BYTE
comment: $9B00 in the source of room charset C is $0F in TBC and DC and $55 in SAEGER. $55 is the first value that the KERNAL RAM test at $FD71 writes before it puts the byte back: a reset in the test left it in the saved image. build_double_height_font copies the byte into the double-height charset at the cold start.

name: FIX_RAM_TEST_BYTE
comment: $9B00 in the source of room charset C is $0F in TBC and DC and $55 in SAEGER. $55 is the first value that the KERNAL RAM test at $FD6E-$FD83 writes to each byte before it writes the old byte back: a reset in the test left it in the saved image. build_double_height_font copies the byte into the double-height charset at the cold start.

name: PROTECTION
comment: The copy protection checks of the original loader marks and the key page $CF00. Each patch takes the passing path with the same registers and flags.

name: RUN_STATE
comment: Values that a run of the game left in the music player before the SAEGER image was saved: the voice state at $E100, flags, the stream fetch operands and a branch operand. The game writes each before it reads it. TBC and DC have the values before any run.

name: TITLE_PICTURE
comment: src/boot.asm shows the Datasoft title picture (src/title_picture.kla) before the loader starts the game. TBC shows the picture in its intro, with CRACKED BY TBC in the bitmap and one screen colour for all cells. SAEGER and DC do not hold it. The switch has no patch: the game bytes do not change.
